title: Where to buy Babyzen Zen stroller in Hong Kong?
label: gear

posts.body:
Hello there!

I've been trying to find a store that sell the Babyzen Zen stroller. I did find the Babyzen Yoyo stroller, but no Zen stroller to try out. So far, only saw the Zen stroller for sale on this website: Ourbaby Online Shop

However, on the Babyzen website, they are warning for fake Zen strollers, so not sure if this website is trustworthy (am new to HK and just started this daunting task of preparing for my baby due end of Oct.).

Does anyone know if there is a store in HK that sell the Zen stroller, so I can try it out? 

Thanks in advance!
